Question: Please tell me dua or wazifah for wealth and health. Answer ID: 146458 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 211/201/B=3/1438) For wealth, recite Ya Mughni ( يا مغني ) 1111 times daily with durood 3-3 times before and after. Also read the following dua extensively: اللهم اسألك من فضلك And for the health, recite the following dua extensively: اللهم إني اسألك العافية، اللهم إني اسألك العافية، اللهم إني اسألك العافية Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
